items.headline: Wanted: A Strategy Chief to Bring Air India’s Two Airlines Closer
items.body: IndiGo hired Air India Express' former chief as its strategy officer in March. Now Air India is creating a strategy role of its own. It looks like both airlines agree the job is worth having.

items.headline: Middle East Tourism Has Split. Which Demand Gets Capital?
items.body: Gulf travel now runs at two speeds. Pilgrimage and resort demand held through 2026, while long-haul and corporate travel fell away. Every 2027 capital and capacity plan for the region depends on which market an operator underwrites.

items.headline: Culture Is Driving New Interest in Travel for Ramadan
items.body: Longer stays and a rise in cultural visits suggest Ramadan is becoming a more significant season in Abu Dhabi’s tourism calendar. The Department of Culture and Tourism - DCT Abu Dhabi now sees an opportunity to turn the holy month into a more deliberate travel proposition for both visitors and the global travel trade.

items.headline: As Dubai’s Hotels Struggle, Branded Homes Keep Launching
items.body: Dubai’s hotels are under pressure, but developers are still signing deals for branded residences. The main bet is on buyers, with brands delivering a healthy premium over the wider market.
